title: Complex analytic theory of Sturm-Liouville operators with Schatten $p$-class resolvents
summary: We use the theory of entire functions of finite order to prove a universal spectral dependence of the blowup/decay rate of solutions of the Sturm-Liouville eigenvalue equation for problems with Schatten $p$-class resolvents. The general form of the asymptotics turns out to depend exclusively on the largest integer $\mathfrak{p}$ such that the underlying resolvents fail to be in the Schatten $\mathfrak{p}$-class.
